title: A 12-year-old photographed a strange UFO outside her bedroom window, then her mother and daughter developed mysterious symptoms
excerpt: An otherworldly experience for the child.

An otherworldly experience for the child.

|

Published: Nov 18, 2026 11:15 am

A family in Wilsonville, Oregon, got the scare of their lives when a strange, see-through UFO flashed bright lights straight through a bedroom window before vanishing into thin air. According to a report filed with the National UFO Reporting Center, the bizarre object had a distorted silver surface, two huge lights, and no clear shape.

The witness said her 12-year-old daughter ran out of her bedroom at 9:14 p.m. after blinding lights lit up the walls. When both parents rushed upstairs to check it out, they saw a massive craft hovering right outside the glass with beams aimed inside. Thankfully, the girl managed to snap a quick photo of the glowing object before it disappeared.

Things got even weirder once the lights went out and the family tried to settle down for the night. The mom reported feeling dizzy and nauseous with balance issues, while her daughter suffered off-and-on headaches until the next morning. Both felt completely fine by the following day, leaving them baffled by what had happened.

The Incident Happened On 25 August 2026

The creepy encounter unfolded on the evening of August 25, 2026, starting around 8:00 p.m. The girl noticed something rectangular drop from the dark sky like a bird shot mid-flight, quickly shifting into a giant ball, then shrinking in a blink.

Just over an hour later, the daughter spotted the craft up close outside her window and yelled for her parents. She described the object as being three airplanes wide with its nose tilted upward and a strange, smoke-like trail behind it. It hovered silently in place for nearly a full minute before vanishing completely from sight.

NUFORC investigator Keith Bickford immediately investigated the sighting to rule out everyday explanations. Local farmers confirmed their crop drones were way smaller, while local police and flight trackers showed zero aircraft in the area. With no normal explanation on the table, Bickford officially logged the case as an unexplained sighting.

NUFORC Shared A Mysterious Incident In October

This Oregon scare follows another weird aerial encounter that NUFORC shared with the public back in October. In that case, pilots flying over Ohio on August 16 spotted a shiny, pill-shaped object floating near their plane during a thunderstorm.

One pilot snapped a photo of the craft, telling investigator Ben Hansen its surface looked like pure polished metal with zero seams or creases. Even stranger, their onboard collision warning system and Cleveland air traffic controllers saw nothing on radar at all. The captain doubted it was a weather balloon since it stood roughly 30 feet tall and survived rough storm turbulence.

Federal aviation officials later confirmed that no planned balloon launches or registered aircraft matched the flight path. Between pilots spotting shiny objects at high altitudes and families catching glowing crafts outside bedroom windows, unexplained sightings keep piling up. For now, both cases remain completely unsolved mysteries on the books.
